networkRules.title: Network rules
networkRules.intro: Limit from which networks and kinds of client a library can be seen. While a library has enabled rules, a request sees it only if it matches at least one of them, and every condition of that rule must hold. Libraries without rules are not affected.
networkRules.adminsNote: Administrators are limited only by rules that include administrators. The device type is decided by the session kind (web browser or native app), which the server issues.
networkRules.emptyHint: Every library can be seen from any network.
networkRules.deletePrompt: If it was the library's last enabled rule, the library becomes visible from every network again.

form.networkHint: LAN means the client address, as resolved through the trusted proxies, is private (RFC 1918), unique local (fc00::/7) or loopback. WAN is every other address.
form.cidrsHint: One per line, such as 192.168.1.0/24, 10.0.0.5 or 2001:db8::/32. Leave empty for any address. At most {max}.
form.tooLong: An entry is longer than {max} characters.
form.invalid: The server cannot use this rule. Check the addresses and prefixes.
